note: Adjudicated variants: 3 accidental (punctuation, capitalization, capital-accents, accents). Substantive text agrees across both witnesses with zero further divergence.

adjudicated.ruling: Colon, with do and with the typical edition: what follows is the second half of the same petition (respícere and accépta habére share dignéris), not a new one.

Stress on the antepenult, with handmissal-eo. Sícuti is sicut with the enclitic i; the u of the penult is short, so the stress cannot fall on it, and do's accent would have the reader say the word wrongly. Accents are the accidental class the collation strips before comparing letters (ORTHOGRAPHY.md), so the difference is adjudicated here rather than declared as a corrigendum — the same course the corpus took at ordinarium.lavabo w007.
House rule (ORTHOGRAPHY.md): accents ARE printed on capitals, and handmissal-eo attests the practice. Ábrahæ has three syllables and its stress falls on the first.
